BiblicalUsage: Masoreth is the bond, the band that binds, and it appears once, in Ezekiel 20:37, where God says He will bring His people into the bond of the covenant.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the bond here is not a chain but a covenant: God binds His people to Himself so they will not wander off.
